name: helm-mobile-app
description: helm on a phone: the renderer in a Capacitor shell, holding several helm instances

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo && echo "APK: mobile-app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync && cap run ios
